title: Objects over Ellsworth runway, weapons storage and B-52 alert pad
summary: Mario Woods tells of Objects over Ellsworth runway, weapons storage and B-52 alert pad, about late 1950s onward at Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I probably heard about four or five other cases and not just in the missile field, but back at Ellsworth also, of objects coming down the runway

plain: Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran, says that from the late 1950s on he heard of four or five cases of unknown objects at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota and in its nearby nuclear missile fields. According to him, objects came down the runway and appeared over the weapons storage area and the pad where B-52 bombers sat on alert, ready to fly. If true, it would mean unknown craft were showing interest in America's nuclear forces.
